explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/420: with F(f,n) = τ((n+⌊f(n)⌋)!)/τ(n!), is lim F((log n)^C, n) = ∞ for large C? The statement asserts that for all sufficiently large real C, F((log m)^C, ·) → ∞; by monotonicity in C this is equivalent to asking for one such C, as documented. Faithful.
